For a wide choice in opting for the right career path, the university offers multidisciplinary study programs in major disciplines like commerce, arts, science, etc.

payload.about_content:
The Sikkim Professional Online University offers completely flexible and affordable online degree programs that are valued by top employers nationwide. The university ensures a dynamic learning environment for students to offer them the international standard of education that assists them in overcoming the complex challenges of the world and business organizations.

The Sikkim Professional Online University was initially known as Vinayaka Missions Sikkim University but later changed to SPU Online (Sikkim Professional University Online) in 2020 under the Amendment Act, 2020 (Act No. 09 of 2020). To offer a virtual interactive learning environment, the Sikkim Professional University online courses offer guest lecturers and seminars for the development of essential skills and abilities among students.

Students enrolled in Sikkim Professional University Online are entitled to a plethora of choices to choose from various online undergraduate and postgraduate courses available in different specializations. The Sikkim Professional University Online is a good choice for working professionals and students, as its prime focus is on the graduates' employability.

payload.hero_description: Established in 2008, the Sikkim Professional University Online is a renowned institution in India that offers quality education and a full-fledged online degree course. The university provides multiple professional degree courses with a virtual interactive learning environment that allows students to interact with faculty and peers to resolve academic queries in no time. It is a strategic choice to pursue Sikkim Professional University's Online degree programs as they are globally accepted and hold immense credibility.
payload.exam_content:
Sikkim Professional Online University Examination Process

For every online degree program offered at Sikkim Professional University Online, the examination process remains the same, which is completely virtual. The examinations are conducted through an online proctored platform that has a continuous monitoring facility.

A laptop, a stable internet connection, and a working webcam are required to appear for the Sikkim Professional University Online examination.
payload.emi_content:
The Sikkim Professional University Online does not provide an EMI facility directly. However, the fee structure of Sikkim Professional University's Online courses is affordable and cost-effective as compared to other universities, which makes it feasible for students to pay their course fees without any financial burden.

Simultaneously, students with financial constraints can seek scholarships offered by the university or seek third-party NBFCs for academic loan services that also offer zero-cost EMI.

The Sikkim Professional University Online scholarships available are mentioned below:

  • MS: Merit Scholarship.
  • EC: University Employees' siblings, wards & spouses.
  • PH: Physically Handicapped.
  • FD: Freedom Fighter/Defence Personnel/Police and paramilitary Wards.
  • SQ: Sikkim Quota Allotment.
  • MC: Minority Concession.
payload.placement_content:
The placement services at Sikkim Professional University Online are offered under its dedicated training and placement cell. The placement cell develops the soft skills and knowledge among the students, motivates them, and enables them to face the challenges in life. The training and placement cell organizes seminars, guest lectures, conferences, project work, and several other academic activities to maintain regular interaction.

The training programs included in the Sikkim Professional University's Online placement services are:

  • Workshop.
  • Entrepreneurial development programs.
  • Industry internship program.
  • Mock interviews, aptitude tests, and group discussions.

The Sikkim Professional University Online has 100+ active recruiters, namely:

  • Cipla
  • Sun Pharma
  • Nexus Computing Solutions
  • ICICI Prudential
  • Lemon Tree Hotels
payload.admission_steps:
Students or working professionals interested in pursuing an online degree from Sikkim Professional University Online are obliged to fulfill the admission requirements of their chosen program and then proceed with the admission process.

The complete Sikkim Professional University Online admission process is listed below with a step-by-step procedure:

  1. Visit the official website of Sikkim Professional University Online and register yourself.
  2. Complete the Sikkim Professional University Online registration process to receive login credentials to the student portal.
  3. Log in to the student portal and start filling out the Sikkim Professional University Online application form.
  4. Fill in the personal information, academic qualifications, and work experience.
  5. Attach the supporting documents along with the application form.
  6. Pay the application fee, submit the form, and wait for admission confirmation.
  7. The university will confirm your admission and share the student enrollment number and other information on your registered email.

NOTE: The Sikkim Professional University Online provides free counselling services to assist students in selecting the best-fit online program and specialization for them.

faqs.question: Is Sikkim Professional University's online degree valid?
faqs.answer: Sikkim Professional University Online is UGC-recognized, and every online degree program offered at the institution is completely valid.

faqs.question: What are the fees of Sikkim Professional University online?
faqs.answer: The fee structure for the Sikkim Professional University Online program varies from one course to another. Simultaneously, the online UG courses cost about INR 75,000 /-, whereas, the online PG course fee is between INR 75,000 /- & INR 1,11,000 /- approximately.

faqs.question: What is the rank of Sikkim Professional University online?
faqs.answer: The ASSOCHAM EduTech has ranked Sikkim Professional University among the Top 100 Universities in The Country in 2022.

faqs.question: Is Sikkim University online UGC approved?
faqs.answer: Yes, Sikkim University online is UGC-approved, and every online degree acquired from it holds the same value as an on-campus degree.
